# PDF.js

Unmodified browser build and text extraction resources from Mozilla PDF.js6.5.438, Apache2.0.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/download/v6.5.438/pdfjs-6.5.438-dist.zip

Archive SHA256: fcbe9ba21d9911843e3502adc178a7f549a524a4055f887bedc942e5490c6ba1

PACT uses the display API for local text extraction in a dedicated worker. The viewer, PDF scripting sandbox and source maps are not included. Character maps and standard font data are self-hosted; no runtime CDN is used.
